answer:
Northwind Logistics reported FY2025 revenue of $412.6 million, up 8.4% year over year [S1]. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 17.2% [S1]. The company operates 38 distribution centers across North America [S1]. Its $150 million term loan matures in March 2029, with a 4.0x leverage covenant [S2]. Management expects low- to mid-single-digit organic growth in FY2026, subject to freight volume recovery [S3].

This summary is not investment advice. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
